thread:
sam: FYI customer 'NovaApps' opened a ticket — their AWS + Azure marketplace invoices show ~12k more units than what our usage dashboard reports for Feb. customer says they were charged for tokens not in our logs.

katie-support: Oof. Ticket #C-9821, customer pasted AWS invoice line item. They say charges hit marketplace account `nova-prod-aws` and `nova-prod-az`.

sam: I pulled their Redwood usage for Feb for account_id `acct_nova_42`: our token sum = 1,192,430 tokens. AWS marketplace line shows 1,304,210 units. delta = 111,780.

jordan-billing: Paging @jordan-billing — can you check if Marketplace metering reports are being double-counted during cross-listing (aws + azure) for the same account? Also any recent changes to partner_id tagging?

maria-devex: Quick data dump I ran: `SELECT marketplace_partner, sum(tokens) FROM usage_events WHERE account_id='acct_nova_42' AND month='2026-02' GROUP BY marketplace_partner;` returns: aws: 1,192,430, azure: 0. That matches our dashboard.

marketplace-sync-bot: marketplace-sync-bot started full sync for 2026-02 at 2026-03-03T09:42:10Z

sam: But AWS invoice shows 1,304,210. Could be marketplace aggregation including retries or meter-reporting for failed requests?

katie-support: I asked the customer for raw invoice CSV, they provided `aws_marketplace_report_feb.csv` — has a dimension `usage_dimension` labelled "units." Looks like there are several lines with `usage_type=overage` and `free-tier-adjustment` that we don't surface.

jordan-billing: I'm seeing a known edge case: older Marketplace metering integration used meter_report_id from partner payload. If partner sent duplicate meter events with different timestamps but same UUID, our ingest dedupe only looked at `event_source`+`timestamp` and missed duplicates where `timestamp` changed server-side. That could inflate AWS numbers. Investigating whether partner's reports were re-sent.

maria-devex: Repro steps I ran locally:
```
# fetch raw partner metering events
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $SYNC_KEY" "https://partners.redwood/api/marketplace/events?account=acct_nova_42&month=2026-02" > raw.json
jq '.events | map({id: .meter_report_id, ts: .reported_at, units: .units})' raw.json | sort -r
```
I see ~30 events where `meter_report_id` repeats but `reported_at` differs by a few seconds. Our import pipeline currently treats those as distinct.

lee-sales: Is this limited to NovaApps? Customer is pretty upset; they already CC'd procurement. If it's systemic we need to notify other marketplace customers.

jordan-billing: Initial patch: change dedupe key to include `meter_report_id` when present. I'll run backfill dedupe for Feb for affected partners. ETA 2 hours for a dry-run.

marketplace-sync-bot: dry-run de-duplication job queued: job_id=job-20260303-1145 (estimated 1.2k entries to inspect)

katie-support: Suggested interim response to customer: we're investigating a marketplace reporting duplication that may have inflated marketplace provider line items. We're running a reconciliation and will update within 6 hours. Would you like us to open a billing dispute with AWS on your behalf?

sam: Also tagging @gcp-partner-rep — check if GCP/Azure partner reports have similar repeat behavior; some partners use the same reporting client.

gcp-partner-rep: I pulled Azure partner feed for `nova-prod-az` — their report shows no duplicates for Feb. Looks isolated to the AWS partner pipeline for now.

jordan-billing: Dry-run results: after dedupe by `meter_report_id`, AWS reported units drop to 1,193,010 — delta vs our dashboard = 580 units; looks like the majority of the 111k gap was duplicates. I'll kick the real de-dupe and re-export the marketplace reconciliation file to send to AWS.

maria-devex: Confirmed: running the reconciliation script locally yields the new AWS line total 1,193,010. Commands used: `python tools/marketplace_reconcile.py --account acct_nova_42 --month 2026-02 --dedupe-by meter_report_id`

lee-sales: Good — can we prepare a credit adjustment and a short note explaining the issue? Procurement will need a file for finance.

jordan-billing: I'll prepare adjusted invoice CSV and a support note. Plan: 1) apply dedupe fixes to prod ingest, 2) re-run full Feb reconciliation for all AWS partners, 3) submit an AWS billing dispute + request credit for affected customers.

katie-support: Customer reply: "Thanks — please escalate, we need a credit or we'll be on pause next billing cycle." :worried:

sam: Priority P1. Assigning follow-ups: @jordan-billing (reconcile + AWS dispute), @maria-devex (prod hotfix + test), @lee-sales (customer comms).

marketplace-sync-bot: marketplace-sync-bot completed dedupe job job-20260303-1145 — 1,162 duplicates removed, affected_accounts=["acct_nova_42","acct_abc_77"]

jordan-billing: Final note: after applying fixes and re-exporting reconciliation, NovaApps corrected AWS charge aligns within tolerance with our usage. I'll attach the adjusted CSV to the customer's ticket and submit the dispute.

katie-support: Closing loop with customer and scheduling a postmortem tomorrow 10:00 PT to walk through root cause and prevention (add `meter_report_id` dedupe into our CI tests). :white_check_mark:
